entries.title: The Alters

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Alters launched on Windows PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S; Windows PC is the best fidelity/capture route and no platform-exclusive gameplay content is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Alters on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or Microsoft Store for Windows PC, or use PC Game Pass if available. The announced Last Variable DLC is future content and should be added after release.

all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture route and full PC storefront support.
skip: console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S console release with Game Pass route.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented; Windows PC is the preferred fidelity/capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Last Variable DLC has been announced for July 2026 but is not released as of June 23, 2026, so it is not part of the current complete route yet.
